name: Sample Pages 9 — Bulk Send for Approval
source: User-provided screenshot export from Figma (Sample Full-Screen Modal Bulk Task - 1). Node ID not captured.
description: Bulk task flow opened as a full-screen modal (Browser type). Header: 'Bulk Send for Approval' + close X. Body: three panes — left candidates list (selectable rows with status chips and remove actions), center approval actions form (apply-mode cards, tabs, contract/approver form cards), right contract document preview with zoom controls. Footer: Cancel left, Send for Approval (disabled until valid) right. Left and right panes are collapsible.

shell.note: Full-screen modal overlays the entire viewport — sidebar and app-bar are covered. Modal chrome is the page shell.

modal-header.description: Modal title bar: 'Bulk Send for Approval' (text-styles.bold.body-lg, system.text-head) + close X icon button right.

panes-body.description: Three-pane horizontal body on a system.surface-strong canvas. Each pane is a white card (corner-radius.md, border system.border-soft). Gap: spacing.standard.md. Left and right panes can collapse to icon rails (see page-10).

candidates-pane.description: Selectable candidate queue. Header row: 'Candidates' (text-styles.bold.body-md) + count chip (6) + collapse icon button. List rows: candidate name (text-styles.bold.body-sm, system.text-head, single-line ellipsis) over role subtitle (text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-mute), status chip right (chip style Colored: 'New' neutral tone, 'Extend' semantic.warning tone, 'Revision' semantic.error tone, 'Request Change' semantic.sem-teal tone), trailing delete icon button (Ghost, icon color semantic.error). Selected row: brand.brand-surface-soft background + stroke.regular left border brand.brand. Footer hint: 'Navigate with Ctrl + ↑ or ↓' with keyboard key caps (system.surface-strong bg, corner-radius.md, text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-mute).

approval-actions-pane.description: Main form pane. Header row: 'Approval Actions' (text-styles.bold.body-md) + 'Info' chip with info icon right + expand icon button. Apply-mode selector: two selectable option cards in a row (radio behavior) — 'Apply to All' (stack icon, title text brand.brand, caption 'Use the same details for all selected candidates.'; selected: border brand.brand + bg brand.brand-surface-soft) and 'Only for [Candidate Name]' (file icon, caption 'Set unique and specific details just for this person.'; unselected: border system.border-soft, bg neutral.pure-white). Below: tabs (UnderlineTextOnly): 'Template & Approval' (active) | 'Attachment (0)'. Tab content: two stacked form cards on system.surface-soft group backgrounds: card 1 — 'Contracy Type' Dropdown (disabled, value 'Contract or PKWT') and 'Version' Dropdown ('Select Version') with trailing 'Edit' button (Outlined, pencil icon); card 2 — 'Approver 1 (KAM)' and 'Approver 2 (KAM)' Dropdowns ('Select Approver').

content-components.note: Label text as in source design ('Contracy Type')

contract-preview-pane.description: Document preview pane. Header row: 'Contract Preview' (text-styles.bold.body-md) + 'Toggle Summary' pill chip with eye icon + collapse icon button. Preview card on system.surface-soft: toolbar row with candidate name (text-styles.bold.body-sm) + zoom controls (− / '100%' / + icon buttons, Ghost); document page below as a white A4-ratio card (shadow, contract text content: centered bold heading lines + numbered clauses, text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-body). Vertical scroll within the pane.

right.note: Disabled until template and approvers are set

customElementsRegistry.bulk-panes-body: Three-pane body on system.surface-strong: 300px candidates pane + flexible form pane + 290px preview pane. Panes are white cards, gap spacing.standard.md.
customElementsRegistry.bulk-candidates-pane: Selectable candidate rows: name + role + colored status chip + error delete icon. Selected: brand.brand-surface-soft bg + brand.brand left border. Footer: keyboard navigation hint.
customElementsRegistry.approval-actions-pane: Apply-mode option cards (radio behavior; selected: brand border + brand-surface-soft bg) + underline tabs + stacked form cards on system.surface-soft.
customElementsRegistry.contract-preview-pane: Preview header + zoom toolbar (− / 100% / +) + white document page card on system.surface-soft canvas.

paper.viewerBackground: var(--color-brand-brand-surface-soft) (pixel-measured rgb 219,234,254 = existing brand surface token)

_provenance.method: PIL pixel scan of the real Bulk 1 / Bulk 2 screenshots
_provenance.notes: contract text transcribed verbatim incl. 'Contracy Type' typo and 'Systems.Selanjutnya' missing space; paper content below the visible fold was NOT invented; Elabram watermark approximated with low-opacity text
